name: figma-rest
description: Figma REST plumbing for Ready Check: pin a design's version for freeze checks, export node snapshots, and audit a file for design-readiness gaps (missing platforms/states, placeholder copy).

tools.name: get_file_version
tools.description: Get a Figma file's current version + lastModified — pin at Ready-Check sign-off to detect later design drift.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List a Figma file's named version history (immutable snapshots).

tools.name: export_node
tools.description: Render a Figma frame/node to an image URL — an immutable visual snapshot.

tools.name: audit_design
tools.description: Audit a Figma file for design-readiness gaps: platform coverage, UI states present, and placeholder copy.

figma_token.title: Figma personal access token
figma_token.description: Read-only token with files:read scope. Get it at Figma → Settings → Security → Personal access tokens. Stored encrypted in your OS keychain.
